This page lists every error code Quarto can emit, with a link to
the per-code reference page. Use the filter above to narrow by
subsystem or status.

The catalog of codes lives in
[`crates/quarto-error-catalog/error_catalog.json`](../../crates/quarto-error-catalog/error_catalog.json).
The pages here are the prose layer over that catalog: where the
catalog says *which* codes exist, the pages explain them.

## Status legend

| Status       | Meaning                                                                              |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `complete`   | Canonical reference. Has met the prose-quality bar described in the README.          |
| `stub`       | A human has reviewed and lightly filled out the page. Not yet a finished reference.  |
| `draft`      | Page exists with auto-generated placeholder body. No human prose yet.                |
| `deprecated` | Newer Quarto versions no longer emit this code, but the page stays live so users on older versions can still look it up. |

See [`docs/errors/README.md`](../../docs/errors/README.md) on
GitHub for the full authoring conventions.
